articles.title: The SEC settles with Coinbase over its missing Gary Gensler texts
articles.snippet: A new court status report reveals the agency will pay a flat fee to resolve a two-year fight over what former Chair Gary Gensler knew about Ethereum.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy groups support CLARITY passage as ethics rules face pushback
articles.snippet: The window for US lawmakers to address a comprehensive crypto market structure bill before the 2026 elections is closing, and industry organizations are calling for action.

articles.title: Internet Freedom Foundation calls India’s BitChat GitHub takedown order ‘unconstitutional’
articles.snippet: The digital rights group says India’s order to remove Jack Dorsey’s BitChat repositories from GitHub exceeds the government’s legal authority and threatens free speech.

articles.title: World Foundation raises $52.5M in Pantera-led funding to expand World ID infrastructure
articles.snippet: The organization sold locked WLD tokens to strategic investors as it seeks to grow its biometric identity network amid rising demand for human verification online.

articles.title: EU widens Belarus ownership ban to all crypto service providers
articles.snippet: The EU will bar Belarusian nationals and residents from owning, controlling or managing exchanges and other MiCA-regulated crypto firms from Aug. 25.
